title: Large Print Sudoku for Seniors: Easy Puzzles with Solutions

audience.description: Adults 55+ seeking accessible, large-print puzzle activity

description: Large Print Sudoku for Seniors features 100 easy 9x9 sudoku puzzles designed for enjoyment and accessibility. Every puzzle is printed one per page at generous size with high-contrast black-on-white grids, making digits easy to read and cells easy to fill. All puzzles are solvable using straightforward logic — no guessing required. Complete answer keys are grouped at the back of the book so solvers can check their work without spoiling the puzzle pages. Whether you are new to sudoku or simply prefer a relaxed, forgiving challenge, this collection offers hours of calm, satisfying puzzle play. 100 unique puzzles. Back-of-book solutions. Large-print 8.5 x 11 format.
short_description: 100 easy large-print sudoku puzzles for seniors — one per page, high-contrast grids, back-of-book solutions.
